topic: Constructed international auxiliary language by Zamenhof
core_question: Which constructed international auxiliary language did L. L. Zamenhof create in 1887?
answer_summary: The answer must name Esperanto as the constructed language created by L. L. Zamenhof.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing terse one-liners
